title: C/Zephyr EDHOC KDF uses wrong info structure (4 elements instead of RFC 9528 3 elements)
description:
## Bug

C `edhoc_kdf()` in `lichen/subsys/lichen/edhoc/edhoc_kdf.c` builds info as `(length, TH, label, context)` - 4 elements.

RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2 specifies `info = (label, context, length)` - 3 elements. TH should be passed AS context by the caller, not as a separate field.

## File
`lichen/subsys/lichen/edhoc/edhoc_kdf.c` - both `edhoc_kdf()` and `edhoc_kdf_int()` functions

## Fix
Same as Python fix in project-LICHEN-worker6-9xfw:
1. Change signature to remove TH parameter
2. Change info encoding to `(label, context, length)`
3. Use integer labels per RFC
4. Update all call sites to pass TH as context where needed

## Blocked by
Must coordinate with Rust fix and regenerate shared test vectors after all three implementations align.
